priority_basis.order: per node, priority_basis.source says which won. file/override: the operator's ordering method (tier + rank in backlog-priority.json). heuristic: has open work > CURRENT-CAMPAIGN.md membership (2 newest block, 1 older) > rows transitively gated via dep edges > ready before blocked; heuristic rows sit below file rows
priority_basis.priority: 0.0 lowest .. 1.0 highest, mid-rank percentile; priority_rank 1 = highest

readiness_values.blocked: open work, but at least one `dep` target still has open > 0
readiness_values.no_open: open == 0, so there is nothing to dispatch and nothing to gate. NOT 'closed': open == 0 also covers a handoff whose remaining boxes are all guarded (DO-NOT-DISPATCH) or refused by backlog_row_check, and naming that 'done' would assert a completion the counts do not support
readiness_values.ready: open work and no `dep` target that still has open work — dispatchable now
